name: Makita UC4051A
blurb: Oregon lists UC4051A with two 3/8″ low-profile .050″ chains: 14″/52 and 16″/56 drive links.
intro: The Makita UC4051A is a corded saw in Oregon's grouped Makita block. Oregon's saw-chain selection guide prints this model in one block with other Makita saws, including the DCS340, DCS400, UC3530A, UC4051A and EA4300F40B. Under that block it prints two chains, both 3/8″ low profile at .050″ gauge: S52 on 14″ (52 drive links) and S56 on 16″ (56 drive links). Oregon does not say which length belongs to which model number. The bar on the saw picks the count. The guide does not print a file size.

bars.note: Oregon prints S52 under this Makita block: 14″ bar, 52 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The block lists several Makita model numbers. No file size is printed.
Oregon prints S56 under this Makita block: 16″ bar, 56 drive links, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The block lists several Makita model numbers. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 7 Nov 2026. The guide does not print a file size on these rows.
